title: Final Velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The final velocity must be correctly stated as v = sqrt(3)/2 * c.

title: Kinetic Energy Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly use the kinetic energy equation T = m_0 c^2 (gamma - 1).

title: Gamma Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of gamma must be correctly derived as gamma = 2.

title: Velocity Relation
description: Important Criteria: The relationship v/c = sqrt(1 - 1/gamma^2) must be correctly applied.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include incorrect signs in the kinetic energy equation or gamma calculation.
